cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

mechanism: A manages family photography by accommodating uncontrollable blinks with rehearsal and time concerns with a new timekeeper.
confusable: Unlike ordinary patience for a photo, A makes each objection justify an additional organized role or rule.
comparison: B chooses rehearsal timing in a photo, unlike B inspecting drink-pouring hands.
seedUse: D192-b blink rota and all-afternoon concern; S02-b gives B a bounded timing role while retaining the system.
